InBranchPicker.note: Borderless transparent input with the muted magnifier sits directly on the popover surface above the hairline divider — the codex recipe, not a boxed field. Branch rows and the Check on `main` render whole.

WithQuery.note: Typed value renders in foreground ink at text-ui and the row list is filtered to the single match; the variant axis (empty vs typed) is legible against InBranchPicker.

NoMatches.note: Query with no hits pairs the field with the real PickerEmptyRow leaf; muted empty copy reads correctly on the popover fill.

Placeholders.note: Two surfaces show the placeholder-only resting state at two different labels; muted placeholder ink and icon alignment are consistent.
